title: Learning Unbiased Permutations via Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.16755v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning permutations is fundamental to sorting, ranking, and matching, but existing differentiable methods based on entropy-regularized Sinkhorn produce a single softened solution and collapse under ambiguity. We present PermFlow, a conditional flow matching framework that operates directly on the affine subspace of matrices with unit row and column sums. A closed-form tangent-space projector preserves these constraints exactly along every trajectory, by construction rather than through iterative correction, and a nearest-target coupling routes distinct noisy initializations toward distinct valid permutations. The result is a model that captures multimodal permutation distributions rather than collapsing them to a single mode. On a range of problems, PermFlow achieves high accuracy on unambiguous inputs and recovers both valid permutations under ambiguity.

translated_title: 通过流匹配学习无偏置换
translated_abstract: 学习置换对于排序、排名和匹配任务至关重要，但现有的基于熵正则化Sinkhorn的可微方法只能产生单一的软化解，在存在歧义时会失效。我们提出了PermFlow，一个直接作用于行和与列和均为1的矩阵仿射子空间上的条件流匹配框架。闭式切空间投影器通过构造方式（而非迭代修正）在每条轨迹上严格保持这些约束，而最近目标耦合将不同的噪声初始化引导至不同的有效置换。由此得到的模型能够捕捉多峰置换分布，而不是将其坍缩为单一模式。在一系列问题上，PermFlow在无歧义输入上达到了高准确率，并且在存在歧义时能够恢复出多个有效的置换。
tldr: PermFlow是一种条件流匹配框架，通过闭式切空间投影直接在双随机矩阵的仿射子空间上运行，能够捕捉多峰置换分布，在无歧义输入上实现高准确率，并在歧义情形下恢复出多个有效置换。
en_tdlr: PermFlow is a conditional flow matching framework that operates directly on the affine subspace of doubly stochastic matrices via a closed-form tangent-space projector, capturing multimodal permutation distributions, achieving high accuracy on unambiguous inputs, and recovering multiple valid permutations under ambiguity.
